question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Copious
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Meager**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Copious"** means abundant in quantity or supply; large in number or amount. (प्रचुर मात्रा में)

 
 
• **Example:** She took copious notes during the lecture to ensure she didn’t miss any important points.
 
 
 
• **"Meager"** refers to something that is lacking in quantity or quality; scanty or insufficient. (अल्प मात्रा में)
 
 
• **Example:** The villagers were struggling to survive on their meager food supplies during the drought.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Copious'** is **'Meager'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Splendid** (शानदार): Something magnificent or very impressive.

 
 
• **Example:** The view from the top of the mountain was absolutely splendid.
 
 
 
• **Excellent** (उत्कृष्ट): Extremely good or outstanding.
 
 
• **Example:** She did an excellent job on her presentation, earning praise from everyone.
 
 
 
• **Practical** (व्यावहारिक): Concerned with actual use or practice rather than theory.
 
 
• **Example:** He offered a practical solution to the problem that everyone could implement.
